metadata.geography: United Kingdom, including Northern Ireland and clearly UK-hosted online events

public_window.rule: Today through today + 28 London calendar days, inclusive; exclude known-ended events and already-started timed events with unknown end. Keep TBC-time events through their date.

metadata.publication_gate: Every public record has independent per-ID pass/correction approval. Pass confirms core date/host/geography, not every detail, live capacity or unrestricted entry. Membership/accreditation and unknowns remain explicit.
metadata.reserve_policy: Never load future_reserve into public assets. Reopen primary event and booking sources before promotion; resolve held conflicts first.
metadata.tags_policy: true only when explicitly stated in inspected event evidence. false means not positively confirmed, not proof of absence. Included paid refreshments are not labelled free.
metadata.ideology_policy: Not classified; organisation affiliation belongs to source inventory and does not establish views of attendees or performers.
metadata.time_policy: ISO offsets use Europe/London event date. time=TBC uses local midnight as a sorting placeholder; hide clock time and export as all-day. Preserve doors separately.
limitations: Public-source coverage is bounded by sources accessible at check time; no found event does not prove none exists.
Unknown fees, age limits, access, availability and refund terms are not invented. Confirm with organiser before booking.
Sold-out or unavailable listings are not labelled cancelled without an explicit cancellation notice.

additional_conservative_holds.reason: Format not confirmed; schema requires in_person, hybrid or online

metadata.source_row_policy: source_row_ids identify discovery/coverage relationships; they do not by themselves assert hosting. Host corrections are in org, host_role and calendar_publisher.
